% Generated by bookrepo.py from book.yaml and results.yaml. Edit those files, not this one.
% \BookDOI is empty until zenodo.py reserve; \BookDOIline prints the whole line, or nothing while it is empty (needs hyperref).
% \BookISBN stays empty here: the free KDP ISBN may appear only in the print edition, and kdp.py interior defines it
% for that build alone, so \BookISBNline prints "Paperback ISBN: ..." in print and nothing in the digital edition.
\newcommand*{\BookVersion}{2.0.0}
\newcommand*{\BookEdition}{2}
\newcommand*{\BookYear}{2026}
% one DOI per volume: the main file of a volume defines \BookVolume (I, II, ...) before \input{bookmeta}
\providecommand*{\BookVolume}{I}
\def\BookVolumeTest{II}\ifx\BookVolume\BookVolumeTest
\newcommand*{\BookDOI}{10.5281/zenodo.23861976}
\newcommand*{\BookDOIline}{Digital Object Identifier (DOI): \href{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23861976}{\nolinkurl{10.5281/zenodo.23861976}}}
\else
\newcommand*{\BookDOI}{10.5281/zenodo.23861971}
\newcommand*{\BookDOIline}{Digital Object Identifier (DOI): \href{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23861971}{\nolinkurl{10.5281/zenodo.23861971}}}
\fi
\providecommand*{\BookISBN}{}
\ifx\BookISBN\empty\newcommand*{\BookISBNline}{}\else\newcommand*{\BookISBNline}{Paperback ISBN: \BookISBN}\fi
